Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

Join our dynamic industrial team at Olsson, where we combine innovation with excellence in the industrial sector.

Recognized as one of the "Best Places to Work," Olsson provides a collaborative environment for engineers to lead in diverse challenges and contribute to significant projects like Ethanol plant upgrades, manufacturing facilities, and renewable natural gas plant designs.

Future growth is anticipated in semi-conductor facilities, advanced manufacturing, above ground mining, pharmaceuticals, and bio energy.

We are seeking an experienced BIM Structural Specialist that performs complex drafting assignments requiring the application of standardized techniques. The design associate works independently and may direct efforts of less experienced staff. This position has diversified design experience, an ability to perform work of a greater complexity, and recommends design techniques and minor design changes to ensure the best approach to solve engineering and design needs.

· Develop and maintain structural LOD 200-400 BIM models in Autodesk Revit, including beams, columns, foundations, walls, and other key components.

· Prepare and update structural drawings, layouts, specifications, details, and schedules for design and construction documentation.

· Create and manage Revit families, templates, filters, and work sets to support project-specific needs and align with company standards.

· Collaborate with civil and process teams to integrate models across platforms such as Civil 3D and Plant 3D.

· Export models to RISA 3D and support structural analysis workflows.

· Generate accurate quantity takeoffs from BIM models to support cost estimation.

· Ensure all models and drawings comply with project requirements, codes (IBC, OSHA, PIP), and company standards.

· Maintain revision control of BIM models and drawing sets, and lead efforts in routing and transmittal of drawings using Bluebeam.

· Conduct quality reviews of models and documentation for accuracy, consistency, and constructability.

· Participate in project coordination meetings and conduct occasional site visits to verify field conditions and support issue resolution.

· Assist in the development of as-built models using 3D point cloud scans.

· Stay current with emerging design tools and techniques to enhance project delivery.

· Work closely with engineers in a collaborative, iterative design process.

· Provide training and mentorship to team members in BIM software and workflows.

· May supervise and review work of less experienced staff.

· May be required to work in various terrain and weather conditions on active construction sites.

· Working collaboratively with others.

· Having ownership in the work you do.

· Using your talents to positively affect communities.

· Collaborating with clients and coworkers to develop custom, impactful solutions.

· Playing an active role in project success—from scoping and design to management and delivery.

· Building meaningful relationships with clients across projects of all sizes.

· Working in a fast-paced environment where each day brings new challenges and opportunities.

· Committed to advancing team goals by engaging in diverse project work.

· Strong communication skills.

· Ability to contribute and work well with a team.

· Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

· Associate degree in a related field preferred.

· A minimum of eight years of experience using Autodesk Revit.

· Autodesk Certified Professional in Revit for Structural Design with experience working on industrial projects.

· Familiar with Navisworks and ACAD software.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

**BIM Manager / ArchiCAD 30-50 %**
Wir sind ein Architekturbüro mit einem internationalen Team. Zusammen entwickeln und realisieren wir Bauvorhaben in der Schweiz. An unsere Projekte stellen wir höchste Qualitätsansprüche in Form und Gestaltung.
Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Arbeitsweise suchen wir eine strukturierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit mit sehr guten ArchiCAD-Kenntnissen.
Sie unterstützen uns bei der Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung unserer BIM- und ArchiCAD-Standards. Sie entwickeln klare Strukturen für die Projektbearbeitung und digitale Ablage und sorgen gemeinsam mit dem Team für deren konsequente Anwendung.
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Projektvorlagen, Layer- und Dateistrukturen sowie die Definition von Standards für eine effiziente und übersichtliche Projektbearbeitung. Sie begleiten unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Umsetzung und stehen ihnen bei Fragen rund um ArchiCAD, BIM und die digitale Projektorganisation zur Seite.
Darüber hinaus halten Sie unsere internen Standards, Normen und Richtlinien aktuell und kümmern sich um die Organisation von Software, Lizenzen und Logins.
Sie verfügen über sehr gute ArchiCAD-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung im Bereich BIM. Sie arbeiten selbständig, präzise und strukturiert und haben Freude daran, digitale Arbeitsabläufe zu entwickeln und verständlich zu vermitteln. Eine Ausbildung als Architekt / in oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung ist von Vorteil.
Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die digitale Arbeitsweise unseres Büros aktiv mitzugestalten und unsere Projekte durch klare und effiziente Strukturen zu unterstützen.

Ontwerp slimme oplossingen en realiseer impactvolle verandering
‘Complexe gebouwen vragen om overzicht, precisie en gevoel voor samenwerking. In deze rol verbind jij architectuur , BIM en uitvoering. Ontwerpmodellen blijven continu in beweging. Juist die dynamiek maakt het werk interessant. Spreekt dat aan? Dan kom ik graag met jou in contact.’
— Sylvie Smeets – teammanager Architectuur
Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Onze business unit Architectuur in Nederland bestaat uit 75 collega’s, verspreid over Maastricht, Eindhoven, Utrecht en Rotterdam. Binnen onze architectuurteams werk jij aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante gebouwen.

Denk aan renovatieprojecten voor MUMC, voor het Catharina Ziekenhuis en projecten voor het COA.(nieuwbouw voor CZE is nog een beetje pre-matuur, we hebben de opdracht nog niet) De teams bestaan uit architecten, modelleurs, kostendeskundigen, bestekschrijvers en directievoerders.

Samen werken zij aan ontwerpen waarin architectuur, techniek en uitvoering samenkomen.
Als BIM coördinator architectuur modelleer en coördineer jij het architectuurmodel. Ook voer jij clashcontroles uit en bespreek jij uitkomsten met opdrachtgevers, adviseurs en collega’s. Het architectuurmodel vormt vaak de basis voor andere disciplines. Daardoor vraagt deze rol om overzicht, flexibiliteit en gevoel voor ontwerpkwaliteit.

Modellen veranderen continu door nieuwe inzichten vanuit constructie, installaties of uitvoering. Precies daar ligt jouw toegevoegde waarde. Ook directievoering op de bouw kan onderdeel worden van jouw rol, als die ambitie er is.
Bij Sweco werk jij aan complexe projecten voor waar multidisciplinaire samenwerking staat centraal. Daardoor kijk jij verder dan alleen het model. Er is veel ruimte om mee te denken over BIM-systematiek, modelafstemming en slimme werkprocessen. Ook binnen het team is ruimte om vakkennis te delen, nieuwe verantwoordelijkheden op te pakken en verder te groeien binnen richting bijvoorbeeld BIM management of projectmanagement.

Dit is wat we jou bieden
Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Om te beginnen ontvang je conform CAO voor Architectenbureaus een goed salaris en 30 vakantiedagen. Daarnaast bieden we een thuiswerkvergoeding, vakantietoeslag, een circulaire thuiswerkplek en een goede pensioenregeling.
Daarnaast krijg je bij Sweco veel regie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Over hoeveel je werkt, waar je werkt, hoe je werkt en wanneer je werkt. Binnen ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket heb je de keuze om te kiezen op welke manier jij reist. We stimuleren duurzame en actieve keuzes en belonen deze extra. Ook krijg je direct toegang tot onze eigen AI-omgeving SwecoGPT, tot de Sweco Academy voor zeer ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden, en tot ons vitaliteitsprogramma gericht op leefstijl en sport.
Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan een tweedaags event voor alle nieuwe collega’s, de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, en activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en de lokale personeelsverenigingen.
Solliciteer op deze functie
Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie!
Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Sylvie Smeets, teammanager Architectuur via +31 6 40 63 57 81 of sylvie.smeets@sweco.nl . Vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je stellen aan Bert aan den Toorn via +31 6 39 44 05 98 of bert.aandentoorn@sweco.nl .

Job Description
Join our team for a unique opportunity working directly with one of the world's largest technology companies.

As a BIM Manager on our Data Centers Facilities Engineering & Design Team, you will collaborate with our BIM team to maintain accurate Revit and CAD files, being the site-level contact for BIM content review, approval, management, and maintenance.

Your responsibilities include playing a crucial part in coordinating the delivery of all handover content for data center projects, utilizing professional tools and processes to ensure accuracy and compliance. This role will require the ability to multitask and work well with our team and a variety of people.
As a BIM Manager, you will also provide document & project closeout support, coordinating content for construction and operation. You will act as the site representative for the Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), working closely with the client and project teams, you'll oversee day-to-day document maintenance, conduct QA/QC checks, and ensure compliance with client standards to meet project deadlines and goals.

Experience using Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Procore, and Bluebeam preferred
Excellent verbal communication skills and a strong work ethic

ARCO/Murray is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive BIM Coordinator to support our field operations and project team onsite in Sullivan, IN. This role works closely with onsite personnel, design teams, and trade partners to ensure seamless design, coordination, and install of complex structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable in an active construction environment, and skilled with BIM design/coordination software.

Serve as the technical BIM advisor in the onsite field office.
Participate in BIM set-up, standards development, and coordination process for project phases.
Establish early data exchange standards with the project team to optimize BIM utilization for scheduling, quantity take-off, estimating, and related functions.
Perform clash detection, coordination reviews, and constructability checks to identify installation conflicts, design gaps, access issues, maintenance concerns, and field execution risks.
Facilitate BIM coordination meetings with engineering teams, construction teams, trade partners, vendors, and design partners to review conflicts, assign action items, track resolution, and maintain schedule alignment.
Partner with field supervision and construction leadership to support model-to-field coordination, installation planning, sequencing, prefabrication, modularization, and layout activities.
Assist project teams with RFIs, design clarifications, field change requests, submittal reviews, shop drawing coordination, and issue resolution related to BIM and coordinated design information.
Assist in model quality checking, digital close-out and asset data encoding for handover
Generate custom views, pull dimensions to ensure that field associates construct according to approved model.

Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, engineering, virtual design and construction, drafting/design technology, or a related field is preferred
Experience using Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Procore, and Bluebeam required
Working knowledge of mission critical systems such as electrical distribution, backup power, mechanical cooling, controls, fire protection, low-voltage systems, security systems, redundancy, and commissioning is preferred.
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, shop drawings, submittals, equipment data, single-line diagrams, coordination drawings, and technical documentation.
Strong understanding of constructability, installation sequencing, trade coordination, RFIs, submittals, field change management, and turnover documentation.
Strong attention to detail, organization, problem-solving, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with clients, project leadership, engineering teams, construction teams, vendors, subcontractors, and trade partners.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Building on the rapid advancement of the Starship program, SpaceX is seeking to rapidly develop and retrofit launch infrastructure facilities to support vehicle builds and re-flight refurbishments.

We are seeking a Building Information Modeling (BIM) Specialist to lead the modeling, integration and coordination of electrical systems for multi-disciplinary Starship and Super Heavy Booster tooling systems, and facilities infrastructure.

This position will serve as a key technical resource, supporting project teams and fostering strong BIM practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Develop, maintain, and upgrade detailed 3D BIM models of electrical systems (power distribution, control systems, data acquisition, wire harnesses, routing, cable management, hardware mounting, and equipment placement) using industry-standard software such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD,or NX
Own, draft, redline, and maintain electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, panel layouts and prepare related documentation while coordinating 3D model placement of electrical systems with the system Responsible Engineers
Integrate electrical systems with architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing (MEP), and other disciplines for Starship facilities and production tooling, in a safe, economical, and reliable way. Lead coordination of electrical systems into living facility models, owning end-to-end integration and electrical documentation ownership
Generate construction documents, quantity takeoffs, visualizations, and as-built drawings from BIM models to support bidding, procurement, on-site execution, and long-term reliability improvements for electrical infrastructure and production systems
Act as a liaison between project stakeholders, internal tooling teams, production leadership, responsible engineers, internal design and construction teams, and third-party consultants throughout the project life cycle
Perform clash detection, model coordination, and constructability reviews focused on electrical systems to identify and resolve conflicts early in design and construction phases
Support the development and maintenance of SpaceX BIM standards, protocols, and workflows for electrical infrastructure; act as the primary technical resource for electrical BIM issues
Lead transition of electrical BIM workflows (including data migration, process documentation, and training); actively drive continuous improvements and optimizations for team processes, quality improvements, faster build times, lower maintenance, project kitting, communication, and feedback loops
Support review and interpretation of power system studies, field data, and electromechanical integration; perform daily task prioritization and risk mitigation; participate in cross-functional meetings providing electrical BIM expertise to inform design decisions
Perform other related duties as assigned to ensure an efficient and effective work environment

Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, or construction management; or associates or vocational certification in electrical design, construction drafting, or design technologies
1+ years of experience in a 3D drafting or BIM specialist/modeling role
1+ years of experience working with electrical systems

Occupational trade school qualification or experience working in an electrical technical role or in the electrical field
Working knowledge of NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70E, NFPA 79 & UL508A codes
Proficiency with BIM tools such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD Electrical, NX, and/or SolidWorks
Proficiency in clash detection, federated modeling, interdisciplinary coordination workflows, and constructability reviews for large-scale or high-rise projects
Experience drafting and maintaining electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, and as-built drawings with strong ownership of documentation practices and revision control
Experience modeling electrical systems in industrial environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to independently drive projects, manage multiple priorities, and succeed in a high-paced team environment with evolving needs

This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
Must be willing to travel to various SpaceX locations for mission critical projects
Flexible to work extended hours and/or weekends to align with residential project deadlines and site operations
